value.rationale: The finding upgrades a typical-in-measure scale to an average-case and all-fixed-finite-moment law uniformly in dimension. This is mathematically substantive because convergence in measure permits rare large spikes and does not by itself determine expectations or moments; the theorem rules out precisely that obstruction at every fixed finite order.
